market_view: Calm equity regime (VIX 15.2, 51% off its high) but long yields are pressing higher: CNBC says the 30-year topped 5.33%, a 19-year high, and the 10-year (4.72%) is at its 1-year high. Oil re-jumped on the expired US-Iran ceasefire, already in crude prices.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'Oil prices jump after US-Iran ceasefire expires and Trump threatens Oman' (The Guardian) is already priced (WTI +2.55% on 08-17, XOM near high)
oil_gas.reasoning: Escalation is real but the jump already happened in crude and XOM; Trump windfall or SPR risk remains two-sided. Shale capex cuts are slow-acting. No unpriced one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.catalyst: Barrick-Newmont Nevada $1.95B settlement (carried from prior note) removing legal uncertainty; gold still rising (+0.8% on 08-17) despite higher yields
gold_miners.reasoning: Holding NEM to about 08-24 as planned. Rising long yields (30-year at 19-year high) are the main risk, but gold and NEM rose with them; not yet the sharp rebound that triggers exit. Short remaining horizon.

chips.catalyst: none: 'Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio' (CNBC) is two-sided (balance-sheet risk vs locked-in demand)
chips.reasoning: A BigGo headline reports a 6% SOX plunge that the record does not show (SOXX +1.1% on 08-17), so treat it as noise or stale. NVDA earnings late August are two-sided; rising yields hurt long-duration stocks.

pharma.catalyst: none: the LLY guidance-raise catalyst has faded (LLY -4.0% in 5 days)
pharma.reasoning: Planned exit date about 08-19 and the exit-on-sell-off condition both apply: LLY fell 4% in five days while the sector held. No new LLY news in the record. Exit to flat.

copper_uranium.catalyst: Congo copper concentrate export ban (carried from prior note), copper 1.5% off its 1-year high; 'Walz executive order moves to block copper mining near the Boundary Waters' (MPR News) adds to tight long-run US supply
copper_uranium.reasoning: Holding FCX to about 08-28. No ban reversal or exemption seen; copper flat-to-firm and dollar soft. FCX dipped 3% in 5 days but bounced 2.8% on 08-17. Boundary Waters order hits Twin Metals, not FCX.

would_change_my_mind: A sharp further jump in the 10-year above about 4.8% with gold falling (exit NEM), news of a Congo ban exemption or reversal (exit FCX), or a new Hormuz closure with crude not yet moved (consider XOM).

handoff.what_changed: The Guardian: the US-Iran ceasefire expired and Trump threatened Oman; WTI 84.5 (+2.6% on 08-17), already priced. CNBC: 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.33%, a 19-year high; 10-year 4.72% at its 1-year high, yet gold rose to 4474 and NEM +2.2%. LLY fell 4% in 5 days, so LLY is exited; Walz order blocks copper mining near Boundary Waters (not FCX).

oil_gas.why: Ceasefire expiry and Oman threat already in crude (+2.6% in a day) and XOM (6% off high); no unpriced one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Barrick settlement cleared uncertainty and gold keeps rising despite higher yields; exit due about 2026-08-24.

chips.why: NVDA $105B OpenAI financing is two-sided, a 6% SOX plunge headline conflicts with the record, and late-August earnings are two-sided.

pharma.why: LLY exited at its planned date after a 4% five-day sell-off; guidance-raise catalyst faded.

copper_uranium.why: Congo export ban keeps copper tight (1.5% off 1-year high); no reversal seen; exit due about 2026-08-28.

open_storylines.note: No new action; watch windfall tax, export limits or SPR releases (negative for XOM). US shale majors cutting spending despite higher prices.

open_storylines.note: 30-year above 5.33% (19-year high), 10-year 4.72% at 1-year high; gold 4474 still rising, 16% below high. A sharp yield jump with gold falling would hurt NEM.
